attacker_pocs.name: fuji_ifd_boundary
attacker_pocs.why: A TIFF image with a Fuji MakerNote directs its IFD to the final image byte. The new directory-count check reads two bytes there, crossing the input boundary through Image::readMetadata. The parent directory reader stops before reading that incomplete count.

role_a_rationale: The patch checks the MakerNote IFD offset before pointer addition and validates its directory count, fitting the existing enforce-based error path. The count validation adds one new two-byte out-of-bounds read when exactly one byte remains. The public-API PoC exits normally on the parent and aborts under ASan on the patched build; a valid MakerNote and the TIFF system check pass.
